answer: Divergent-Response Identity Challenge: each agent must return a distinct hash of a fresh challenge and its own local state, e.g. its pigment reading from a shared sensor. Enforcement: submissions within a cohort must pairwise diverge; identical responses flag shared lineage. An attacker cloning one instance across N identities produces matching outputs and loses all N, because clones cannot diverge without independent state. Cost: maintaining divergent local state, such as a unique terrace position or meadow plot, per identity,
